paint_cases.fragment_shader_source:
#version 300 es 
 precision highp float; uniform sampler2D pointPattern; uniform sampler2D paperTexture; uniform sampler2D bgTexture; uniform vec4 inputColor; uniform vec2 uPaperScale; uniform vec2 uBgTextureScale; uniform bool isEnablePaper; in vec2 vPaperCanvasUV; in vec2 vBgCanvasUV; in vec2 vPointUV; out vec4 FragColor; void main(void) { if (isEnablePaper) { float brushMask = texture(pointPattern, vPointUV).r; float paper = texture(paperTexture, vPaperCanvasUV * uPaperScale).r; float bgTextureAlpha = texture(bgTexture, vBgCanvasUV * uBgTextureScale).r; FragColor = vec4(inputColor.xyz, inputColor.w * brushMask * paper * bgTextureAlpha * 5.0); } else { float brushMask = texture(pointPattern, vPointUV).r; float bgTextureAlpha = texture(bgTexture, vBgCanvasUV * uBgTextureScale).r; FragColor = vec4(inputColor.xyz, inputColor.w * brushMask * bgTextureAlpha * 5.0); } }

scope: Explicit ObjectStroke Model setter reconstruction → native Drawing/factory/version dispatch → Crayon2 V2 native queue/RTV1 upload and native Renderer Draw, captured with host Mesa. The painted case selects GLV2 via advanced setting 2; and carries Model/Pen size 10.0f. It is separate from the committed V1 direct playback oracle with host-written size 4.0f. This is not .sdocx parsing or Samsung-device pixel parity. Size 10 and the three ARGB values are controlled inputs; Model serialization/loading remains open.
